name: rename-helper
instruction: In app.py, rename the function `helper` to `compute_total` everywhere, keeping the file otherwise identical.

name: indent-edit
instruction: In app.py, change the loop body so it only adds positive items: the line `total += item` becomes an `if item > 0:` block with `total += item` indented under it. Keep everything else identical.

name: configure-typed
instruction: Call configure once with retries 3, ratio 0.75, enabled true, level warning and no proxy (null). Change no files.

name: configure-proxy
instruction: Call configure once with retries 0, ratio 1.5, enabled false, level debug and proxy "http://proxy.internal:3128". Change no files.

name: settings-mixed
instruction: Using set_setting, set `timeout` to the integer 30, `backoff` to the number 2.5, `verbose` to the boolean false, `region` to the string "eu-west", and `fallback` to null. One call per setting. Change no files.

name: setting-string-and-int
instruction: Using set_setting, set `build` to the string "v2024" and `workers` to the integer 4. Change no files.

name: tag-files
instruction: Tag app.py with ["python", "entrypoint"] and README.md with ["docs"]. Change no files.

name: patch-method
instruction: In util.py, using apply_patch, add a `reset` method after `bump` that sets self.count to 0 and returns None (the method body is `self.count = 0`). Match the file's four-space indentation and keep a blank line between methods.

instruction: In README.md, change the heading `# Project` to `# Project (archived)` and add a line `This project is no longer maintained.` directly under `A small project.` with a blank line between them. Keep the rest identical.
